from google.cloud import vision

def detect_labels(image_path):
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    with open(image_path, 'rb') as image_file:
        content = image_file.read()
    image = vision.Image(content=content)
    response = client.label_detection(image=image)
    labels = response.label_annotations
    print('Labels:')
    for label in labels:
        print(label.description)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    detect_labels('path/to/image.jpg')

from google.cloud import vision

def describe_image(image_path):
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    with open(image_path, 'rb') as image_file:
        content = image_file.read()
    image = vision.Image(content=content)
    response = client.label_detection(image=image)
    labels = response.label_annotations
    description = ' '.join([label.description for label in labels])
    print('Description:', description)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    describe_image('path/to/image.jpg')

from google.cloud import vision

def detect_text(image_path):
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    with open(image_path, 'rb') as image_file:
        content = image_file.read()
    image = vision.Image(content=content)
    response = client.text_detection(image=image)
    texts = response.text_annotations
    print('Texts:')
    for text in texts:
        print(text.description)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    detect_text('path/to/image.jpg')

from google.cloud import vision

def score_safety(image_path):
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    with open(image_path, 'rb') as image_file:
        content = image_file.read()
    image = vision.Image(content=content)
    response = client.safe_search_detection(image=image)
    safety = response.safe_search_annotation
    print('Safety:', safety)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    score_safety('path/to/image.jpg')

from vision_client import get_vision_client, get_image
from vision_models import normalize_labels, normalize_text, normalize_safety

def summarize_analysis(image_path):
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = get_image(image_path)
    label_response = client.label_detection(image=image)
    text_response = client.text_detection(image=image)
    safety_response = client.safe_search_detection(image=image)
    labels = normalize_labels(label_response)
    texts = normalize_text(text_response)
    safety = normalize_safety(safety_response)
    print('Summary:')
    print('Labels:', labels)
    print('Texts:', texts)
    print('Safety:', safety)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    summarize_analysis('path/to/image.jpg')

from google.cloud import translate

def translate_text(text, target_language='en'):
    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()
    parent = client.location_path('your-project-id', 'global')
    response = client.translate_text(parent, text, target_language)
    return response.translations[0].translated_text

if __name__ == '__main__':
    description = 'Sample image description'
    translated_description = translate_text(description)
    print('Translated Description:', translated_description)

from google.cloud import storage

def archive_image_analysis(image_path, analysis_results):
    client = storage.Client()
    bucket = client.bucket('your-bucket-name')
    blob = bucket.blob(image_path)
    blob.upload_from_string(analysis_results)
    print('Image analysis archived successfully.')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    image_path = 'path/to/image.jpg'
    analysis_results = 'Sample analysis results'
    archive_image_analysis(image_path, analysis_results)
